mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market and weak economic growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate recession.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle economic expansions, slowing industrial production growth signals diminishing economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in an impending slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP level indicates strong economic growth, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings prospects improve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is rising, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or the average return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, rising federal funds rates compress equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of monetary tightening cycles, or the average return in these cycles is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (the 2017 base index), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic output.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the average return in these periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
